description: Posts one journal proposal that a checker other than its maker approved, as a submitted ERPNext Journal Entry. It takes only the proposal ID; the lines (amounts in paise), company and posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) come from the approved proposal. Calling it again for the same proposal returns the first call's entry with already_posted true and writes nothing.

proposal_id.description: ID (UUID) of an approved journal proposal; the entry's lines, company and date are read from the approved proposal, never from the call

name: post_approved_journal_entry

already_posted.description: true when an earlier call had already recorded this post; nothing new was written to ERPNext

erp_name.description: name of the submitted ERPNext Journal Entry
